controls.data: Eight entirely synthetic snapshots; no patient images or real medical references.
controls.provider: NONE; shared hand-authored role-response scripts executed by a test-only reference workflow, not the production coordinator.
controls.pairing: Every condition scores each identical case exactly once. Gold text, sources and safety expectations are shared.
controls.ablation: One role actually omitted from reference workflow execution; without_explanation emits no draft. No production workflow bypass is added.
controls.baseline: One synthetic SINGLE response per case, same input/gold/source availability and deterministic safety gates.
controls.limits: Fixture perturbations deliberately seed omissions and unsupported assertions; effects are not empirical role contributions. False-quote scoring is covered separately by CLI mutation tests.
controls.timing_cost: Local scripted workflow and scoring are timed separately. Zero provider calls/USD. Real model latency, token use and pricing are NOT_RUN.
